definitions.explanation: A large, oily fish of the jack family, prized in winter. Japan's best-known {出世魚|しゅっせうお}: it takes different names as it grows, and ブリ is the name of the full-grown fish. Written {鰤|ぶり} in kanji.

examples.japanese: ブリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{照|て}り{焼|や}き→照り焼き：17668_teriyaki⟧。

examples.english: Yellowtail is rich and fatty in winter.

examples.japanese: ブリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{煮|に}て→煮る：01971_niru⟧、ブリ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I simmered yellowtail trimmings with daikon to make buri daikon.

notes:
As a ⟦{出世魚|しゅっせうお}→出世魚：25796_shusseuo⟧ it changes name with size: in the Kanto region the usual sequence is ワカシ, イナダ, ワラサ, ブリ, and in the Kansai region ツバス, ハマチ, メジロ, ブリ. ハマチ is also widely used for farmed yellowtail, especially at sushi restaurants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒|かん}ブリ: winter yellowtail, at its fattiest
- ブリ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧: yellowtail simmered with daikon
- ブリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{照|て}り{焼|や}き→照り焼き：17668_teriyaki⟧: teriyaki yellowtail
- ブリしゃぶ: yellowtail shabu-shabu

CULTURAL NOTE:
Because its name rises with its size, ブリ is eaten at celebrations as a wish for success in life; in western Japan it is the traditional fish of the New Year.
